Chronology

Timeline

A working chronology in which approximate dates remain approximate and unresolved events remain visibly unresolved.

1871
EVT-1871-BIRTHUser supplied

Genealogical research identifies the birth of Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb in Vienna.

Sources: SRC-011

Caution: The original baptismal entry has not been incorporated.

circa 1910
EVT-C1910-SAVOY-SECONDARYConflicting evidence

A secondary source begins a Baur en Ville management period attributed to 'I. Gottlieb'.

Sources: SRC-018

Caution: Do not identify 'I. Gottlieb' as S. H. or Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb without evidence.

1911
EVT-1911-SAVOYPreviously verified

Earlier research found S. H. Gottlieb identified as director of Baur en Ville or Savoy.

Sources: SRC-003

Caution: Reacquire the exact advertisement and metadata before formal public citation.

1914
EVT-1914-SAVOYVerified direct

A contemporary travel guide describes S. H. Gottlieb as Direktor of the Savoy-Hotel Baur en Ville.

Sources: SRC-004, SRC-019

Caution: This does not prove uninterrupted service between the separately documented dates.

before or around 1922
EVT-BEFORE-OR-AROUND-1922-POSTCARDVerified direct

A historic promotional-postcard catalog record associates S. H. Gottlieb with Baur en Ville management.

Sources: SRC-002

Caution: The postcard has no verified exact date in the dossier.

1922
EVT-1922-SAVOYVerified direct

A Swiss travel guide explicitly lists S. H. Gottlieb as director of Savoy-Baur en Ville.

Sources: SRC-001

Caution: The source does not by itself prove that S. H. Gottlieb was Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb.

1922
EVT-1922-VICTORIAVerified direct

The same travel guide lists Zürich's Hotel Victoria under A. Kummer-Wenger.

Sources: SRC-001

Caution: This records the 1922 listing and does not by itself resolve the separate 1924 Gottlieb lead.

1924
EVT-1924-GRAND-HOTEL-VICTORIANeeds recheck

Earlier research identified a possible association between S. H. Gottlieb and Grand Hotel Victoria.

Sources: SRC-006

Caution: Do not state that Gottlieb was the hotel's director.

1929
EVT-1929-HOTEL-MESSMERIndexed lead

Marketplace metadata indicates a Hotel Messmer advertisement associated with Gottlieb.

Sources: SRC-007

Caution: The underlying advertisement has not been transcribed or independently preserved.

since 1930 (reported retrospectively)
EVT-1930-HOTEL-MESSMER-CLOSEDOfficial secondary

An official Baden-Baden historical account reports that Hotel Messmer had been closed since 1930.

Sources: SRC-021

Caution: The underlying archival files were not inspected, and later directory listings create an unresolved conflict.

20 March 1931
EVT-1931-HOTEL-MESSMERVerified direct

A contemporary notice identifies Sylvester Hermann Gottlieb as a hotelier and Pächter of Hotel Meßmer in Baden-Baden.

Sources: SRC-020

Caution: Pächter means lessee or operator, not proven property owner; the notice does not state why the bankruptcy proceeding was terminated.

early 1930s
EVT-EARLY-1930S-HOTEL-MESSMERPreviously verified

Earlier research identified telephone-directory listings using Inhaber for S. H. Gottlieb at Hotel Messmer.

Sources: SRC-008, SRC-009

Caution: The exact pages must be reacquired. Inhaber must be interpreted in its commercial context, and the listings conflict with the retrospective report that the hotel had been closed since 1930.

1938
EVT-1938-SAVOY-CENTENARY-BOOKCatalog verified

Hans Schulthess's Savoy centenary history was published in Zürich.

Sources: SRC-010

Caution: The publication may clarify the management conflict, but its relevant contents have not been inspected.

unknown
EVT-DEATH-UNKNOWNOpen question

The date and place of death remain unresolved.

No supporting source yet — open question

Caution: Do not infer a death year or place.
